department: Department of Physics (School of Computing, Data Sciences & Physics)

deadline.value: No deadline could be verified: the physics admissions page on cdsp.wm.edu returned errors, and the catalog defers to each program's own deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE scores, general or physics subject, are not required and do not hurt an application if left out.
gre_general.quote: The general and physics subject GRE scores are not required but may optionally be supplied | The absence of GRE scores will not negatively affect the application

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE Subject test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: The general and physics subject GRE scores are not required but may optionally be supplied

supervisor.value: The physics page does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department will try to fund PhD students who make satisfactory progress, but the page does not say what share is funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants with only a bachelor's degree are admitted directly to the PhD but must finish the M.S. requirements before the PhD work.
entry_route.quote: Students are admitted directly to the Ph.D. program | Students applying with an undergraduate degree must satisfactorily complete the M.S. requirements before working towards the PhD.

english_waiver.value: The physics program can recommend a waiver of TOEFL or IELTS for applicants whose degree was taught in English; an Indian degree needs that recommendation.
english_waiver.quote: Upon the recommendation of the physics program the TOEFL/IELTS requirement can be waived for applicants who will have received a degree from a college or university in which English is the primary language of instruction

notes: Physics PhD in the CDSP catalog. Deadline page cdsp.wm.edu/admissions/graduate/physics/ is blocked (502), so the deadline is Not stated. Application fee is the CDSP $50, same as the university record.
name: Physics, Ph.D.
